notes.title: Minor patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
This minor patch makes adjustments to the following:

[list]
[*]
Advanced resource buildings - minor increase to resources generated.
[*]
T1 Turrets - Some, not all, turrets saw a damage increase. 
[*]
T2 Turrets - minor increase to damage dealt, slight reduction in resource cost.
[*]
T3 Turrets - A slightly greater damage increase, and a slightly greater resource cost reduction.
[/list]

I will continue to monitor achievement attention rates and update the game accordingly. If needed, the next update would be a change to allow more buildable terrain in the Rocky Hills maps. 

The Desert maps are in a good place and the Alien maps are much more forgiving and act as a safe starting point for players. The Alien may see a terrain difficulty increase, if anything.

Thank you all for your time and support. Best of luck out there. 

Ad Astra, Commanders!

notes.title: Steam Deck & Steam Cloud Ready!
notes.content:
I am proud to announce that Ad Astra: Sci-Fi Tower Defense will support both Steam Deck & Steam Cloud saves on release! 

Steam Deck:
You will need to bump the graphics settings to "Low" to maximize performance, but the game is certainly playable on Steam Deck, without Proton or compatibility settings needed!

You will find a custom button layout template available for download but I have outlined the key buttons below in case you wish to make your own setup.

[b]WASD -[/b] ideally bound to Left joystick
[b]Right Trackpad - [/b]Mouse control

[b]Time Dilation 1-4 - [/b]D-Pad (Down = 1x, Left = 2x, Up = 4x, Right = 6x)

[b]Left click/Confirm -[/b] Right bumper
[b]Right click/Cancel -[/b] Left bumper

[b]Left stick click -[/b] Hide building UI
[b]Right stick click -[/b] Reset camera/overview 

[b]A - [/b]Pause game
[b]B -[/b] Right mouse click/cancel (duplicate)
[b]X -[/b] Rotate building placement left
[b]Y -[/b] Rotate building placement right

[b]Left Trigger -[/b] Rotate camera left
[b]Right Trigger -[/b] Rotate camera right

[b]Backgrip L4 -[/b] Tilt camera up
[b]Backgrup R4 -[/b] Tilt camera down
[b]Backgrup L5 [/b]- Mouse scroll wheel down, zoom out
[b]Backgrup L6 -[/b] Mouse scroll wheel up, zoom in

You can always setup your own preference but these are the official bindings available for use. This post should help remind you what you need to bind :]

Steam Cloud:
The player's progress will be backed up, not the user settings. This way, the resolution and performance are not carried over from your tower to the Steam Deck, or vice-versa. None of that annoying resolution swaps or quality adjustments on machine swap! :]

Cheers everyone!
